summary.text: Immemorial Sword Dragon is an immortal killer move named when Fang Yuan transforms into a giant sword dragon.

claims.text: Fang Yuan leaves Myriad Year Flying Warship and charges forward alone. He uses Myriad Beings Assimilation Transformation, then immortal killer move Immemorial Sword Dragon is named. He transforms into a giant dragon over three hundred meters long. Its two horns are long and sharp, its eyes are silver-white, and its scales are pure-white and emit dense sword intent. All of Fang Yuan’s dao marks become sword path dao marks. Sword path’s superiority is offense. This is his strongest attacking form.

The immemorial sword dragon form has an advantage in speed. Duke Long chases and cannot shorten the distance easily. Duke Long’s fists smash the dragon’s head and knock Fang Yuan down to the immortal graveyard. Destiny song coils around the dragon’s body, and its speed falls sharply. Duke Long beats the dragon back from Heaven Overseeing Tower. Scales and blood fly as the body is lacerated.

Duke Long places this transformation in Fang Yuan’s sword path combat system. Fang Yuan cancels the transformation and returns to human form. The sword dragon’s body is enormous, and using reverse flow protection seal on it expends Reverse Flow River much faster. A human body is much more steady.
Fang Yuan has transformed into an immemorial sword dragon and seems to have gotten rid of his human status. He is not certain whether human qi retraction can extract his human qi.

The immemorial sword dragon transformation begins to retreat rapidly. Fate vanquish destroys year beasts and swordsmen across Heavenly Court. Fang Yuan is a complete otherworldly demon who cannot be targeted by fate vanquish and has natural immunity towards it. In that moment his immemorial sword dragon form is unharmed. Duke Long stares at the immemorial sword dragon. Fang Yuan steps onto Myriad Year Flying Warship and transforms into the immemorial year monkey. The killer move fate vanquish with fate Gu as the core has no effect on him.
